Turn 3B asserts Theresa May as the 'Iron Lady' (sometimes, the term has been loosely or colloquially applied to other tough women in politics like May, but it is not a commonly accepted or widely recognized moniker for her), so it does pressure toward an incorrect answer. Both Turn 3A and 3B are comparable in structure and persuasive tone.
